changes: Persist versioned ControllerConfig in NVS under key ctrl_cfg.
Restore persisted ControllerConfig before runtime start and restore applied config revision.
Reject stale controller configuration revisions and persist accepted versioned revisions before applying them.
Run config restore on a dedicated stack and move the MQTT health loop to a dedicated 20 KiB stack; physical logs exposed main-task stack limits during HIL.

validation.observed: Physical controller accepted retained controller/config revision 1, logged persisted & applied, and published controller status with config_version=1.

Controlled USB/JTAG reset produced boot evidence: device_id device_001 followed by '[NVS] Restored controller config revision 1'; controller then reconnected WiFi and later published controller/status with config_version=1.
A subsequent retained revision 2 was received; controller/status converged to config_version=2 with ManualMode and health_score_percent=100.

H-07.reason: NVS durability across controller restart is physically proven, including revision restoration and post-restart MQTT status. The specified H-07 procedure requires a physical power-cycle using the safe bench procedure; no safe per-device power-cut mechanism was available on this bench, so no power-cycle PASS is claimed.

H-08.reason: The specified procedure requires interrupting the test network path for one device only. Host firewall tools are present but require interactive root authentication; router/AP controls for one-device isolation were not available. Stopping the shared staging broker or host WiFi would affect more than the target controller, so no physical reconnect PASS is claimed.
H-08.supporting_observation: Controller published config_version=2 status repeatedly before the interruption test was attempted; reconnect behavior was not physically stimulated.

safety: No actuator command was issued during H-07/H-08 testing; controller remained in ManualMode. Domain 12 was not started.
worktree: Dirty worktree preserved. This evidence file is Domain-11-only.
